name: @kanzo-tech/graph
description: Kanzo graph view — a fossil corpus attached to the page's DuckDB, read through the page's Mosaic coordinator as one more client, laid out and drawn with cosmos.gl on the GPU. Sibling of @kanzo-tech/ui, not part of it: the admission rules exclude graphs from the generic vocabulary by name.
//peers: All required. cosmos.gl draws and lays out; `lucide-react` is the icon set the parts draw their buttons with, `@kanzo-tech/ui`'s own peer; `@kanzo-tech/mosaic` is the coordinator the graph reads through as a client and the crossfilter it listens to and publishes into. The Mosaic stack itself — mosaic-core, mosaic-sql — is `@kanzo-tech/mosaic`'s peer, declared once there.
//fossil: The graph reads a corpus fossil's `open` (`@fossil-lang/corpus` ≥ 0.3.0-alpha.24) attached under a name — its tables, `fossil_tables` and `fossil_columns` — with SQL through the coordinator. It imports nothing of fossil's: the contract is the catalog, `/docs/format`.
//size-limit: Budgets our code only: `ignore` mirrors the peers the build externalises in vite.config.ts, cosmos.gl included (about 190 kB gzipped on its own, and the consumer pays it once whatever this package does). First measured 2026-09-30 at 19.07 kB, before the lag work of `perf/phase1-lag`; 19.13 kB before the whole-corpus store deleted the tileset, 15.29 kB after it, and the budget follows it down so real growth trips the gate. Raised to 18 kB on 2026-10-01 as a decision: 17.71 kB after GraphCounts, GraphSearch and GraphLooks moved in from the workspace showcase (their code left the host, it did not appear from nowhere) and the drag-to-fix release. Raised to 18.5 kB on 2026-10-02 as a decision (Ángel): 18.01 kB once the layout's square placement and the camera that follows a running layout landed. Raised to 19 kB on 2026-10-03 as a decision (Ángel): 18.58 kB once GraphSelect moved in from the hosts (which drop their copies) and the camera stopped reading positions cosmos.gl had not uploaded. Raised to 22.5 kB on 2026-10-03 as a decision (Ángel), once for the whole Discover integration rather than per change: 18.8 → 22.04 kB with GraphPlacement moved in from the hosts and the named label levels (+1.1), the store keeping the arrangement across canvases (+0.2), GraphSearch as a palette and GraphInspector with its card and neighbourhood (+2.1), less the pins that left (−0.4) — features, not drift. Followed down to 22.3 kB on 2026-10-05: 22.29 kB once the named looks left GraphLooks and the panel became the axes alone (#79). Followed down to 22.2 kB on 2026-10-07: 22.07 kB once GraphSelect left for usePick and the key was read from the manifest, then 22.12 kB with the legend's 'x of N' per category. Raised to 22.5 kB on 2026-10-07 as a decision (Ángel): 22.49 kB once the search read the subset and counted what lies outside it.
